info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Event History API
info.description: The Customer Event History API provides a comprehensive view of the events related to customer interactions within the banking system. By leveraging this API, businesses can track and analyze customer behavior, access transaction records, and enhance customer relationship management. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and customer service teams who need insights into customer activities for reporting and decision-making purposes. This API ensures that you have detailed historical data at your fingertips, allowing for improved service offerings and customer engagement.

get.description: Fetch the event history for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. This includes all relevant interactions, activities, and milestones associated with the customer over time.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the parameters needed to retrieve the customer event history for a specific customer identified by 'CUST-100045'.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning customer event history.

GetCustomerEventHistoryForCustomerCUST10.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the customer event history API. It is expected to contain a JSON string that encapsulates the relevant data.

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party associated with the customer.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the customer.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the relationship becomes effective.

relationshipTier.description: Tier level of the customer's relationship.

version.description: Version number of the customer event history record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

GetCustomerEventHistoryForCustomerCUST10.description: Schema representing the response for fetching customer event history.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Metadata information related to the customer event history response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This helps in tracking and logging requests to specific APIs.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the request. This field is useful for identifying which application made the API call.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method, allowing clients to authenticate using a JSON Web Token (JWT). The token should be included in the Authorization header as 'Bearer {token}'.
